excavation_context.uniform: A light red tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, red shorts and black hiking boots.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_5 is positioned over a laboratory preparation cradle, using a fine micro-chisel and a tiny mallet on a dense sheet of charcoal black shale. He is painstakingly working the marine matrix material surrounding the fossil to lift a massive, curved Baryonyx thumb claw away from embedded prehistoric fish scales and ammonite shells. Stark studio lighting. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
